# NiceSalt

NiceSalt is a small studio for founders, experts, and teams building
something complicated. It is independent project work by David Berzin
(https://davidberzin.com), who has spent fifteen years leading product and
data teams at Hearst, Viacom, and four venture-backed health startups,
including as Chief Product Officer, across global scopes, multi-tenant
platforms, patented ML, and data products. Health, science, and consumer
products are where most of the recent work sits. We connect positioning, product,
content, and measurement into one system, rather than treating them as
separate projects.

## Services

- Positioning & narrative: what you're saying, who it's for, and why it lands
- Product & platforms: working software, from a demo you can click to a platform that carries load
- Content & publishing systems: the site or app, plus the editorial engine behind it
- Measurement & growth: data you can trust, and the experiments that follow

## Engagements

- Teardown: free, returned within 48 hours. Send a site, product, prototype, or deck and get a specific read on what it's costing you and what to fix first. Request at https://nicesalt.com/free-teardown/
- Project sprint: from $25,000, four to six weeks, fixed scope. Positioning, the build, and the measurement.
- Advisory: from $6,000/month, ongoing, for teams making real product, data, and AI decisions.

## Selected work

- ExplorerHealth.co (https://nicesalt.com/case-studies/explorer-health/): AI-assisted harm-reduction health product: interactive assessment, evidence content, privacy-first positioning.
- RobinBerzinMD.com (https://nicesalt.com/case-studies/robinberzinmd/): publishing platform for a physician's articles, newsletter, courses, and book, with a clear path from reader to lead.
- Bibo (https://nicesalt.com/case-studies/bibo/): AI-native audiobook concept demo. One classic becomes five versions (shortened, genre-shifted, translated, re-narrated), with AI cover art, social-first discovery, and an audio-ad concept. Live at https://biboai.vercel.app/

## Notes

- A working demo beats a deck (https://nicesalt.com/notes/a-working-demo-beats-a-deck/): why we built an AI-native audiobook concept instead of writing the strategy document.
- Production got cheap. Judgment didn't. (https://nicesalt.com/notes/production-got-cheap-judgment-didnt/): anyone can ship a decent-looking site now; the scarce skill was never production, it's judgment.
- Why expert sites undersell the expert (https://nicesalt.com/notes/why-expert-sites-undersell-the-expert/): three structural reasons expert websites read weaker than the people behind them.
